description: Bihar has unveiled an ambitious vision to emerge as a major technology and innovation hub, with the state government setting a target of attracting ₹5 lakh crore in investments in the Information Technology (IT) sector. The initiative is part of a broader strategy aimed at promoting artificial intelligence (AI), strengthening digital infrastructure and creating large-scale employment opportunities for the state's youth.
